title: A robust and conductive 3D Fe(II) MOF as a durable cathode for aqueous zinc-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,2698-2706
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00273G, Paper
Soumen Khan, Santanu Chand, Prahlad Yadav, Debasis Ghosh, Chanchal Chakraborty
A highly robust, conductive 3D triazolate Fe-MOF serves as a standalone cathode for AZIBs, offering promising specific capacity with 60% retention over 2100 cycles. This study showcases the potential of 3D MOF in energy storage through AZIBs.
